## Overview

[wuji-hand-teleop](https://github.com/wuji-technology/wuji-hand-teleop) is a ROS2-based teleoperation system for real-time control of Wuji Hand and Tianji Arm using multiple input devices. It includes a Monitor GUI for one-click launch and device monitoring.

<Callout type="warning">
This project is not actively maintained, and no after-sales support is provided. If you encounter issues, please [open an issue](https://github.com/wuji-technology/wuji-hand-teleop/issues)—responses aren't guaranteed. Product version coming soon.
</Callout>

**Supported devices**

| Type | Device | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| Hand input | MANUS Glove | Data glove |
| Hand input | PICO 4 + Tracker | VR headset + hand tracker |
| Hand input | Custom device | Publish to `/hand_input` topic |
| Arm input | HTC Vive Tracker | External tracker |
| Arm input | Custom device | Publish TF to `left_wrist`/`right_wrist` |

**Related repositories**

| Repository | Purpose |
|------------|---------|
| [wujihandros2](https://github.com/wuji-technology/wujihandros2) | Wuji Hand ROS2 C++ driver (included as submodule) |
| [wuji-retargeting](https://github.com/wuji-technology/wuji-retargeting) | Hand pose retargeting algorithm (pip install) |
| [wuji-hand-description](https://github.com/wuji-technology/wuji-hand-description) | URDF / MJCF model descriptions (this repo's `src/wujihand_urdf/` contains the URDF for RViz visualization) |

## Hardware BOM

For the complete list of hardware components required to build this teleoperation system, see the [Hardware Bill of Materials](https://docs.google.com/document/d/19Md8R5tw9OyTvOUD-JKt7S6xMivlHVSCSNAKuoZr1eo/edit?tab=t.0).

## System requirements

| Item | Requirement |
|------|-------------|
| OS | Ubuntu 22.04 LTS |
| ROS2 | Humble |
| Python | 3.10+ |

## Installation

### 1. Install ROS2 dependencies

```bash
sudo apt install ros-humble-desktop
sudo apt install ros-humble-ament-cmake ros-humble-rclpy ros-humble-std-msgs ros-humble-tf2-ros
pip install numpy scipy pyyaml PyQt5 openvr
```

### 2. Install external dependencies

```bash
# wujihandcpp C++ SDK (pre-installed in Docker; for bare metal see src/wujihandros2/README.md)

# Hand retargeting algorithm
cd ~/ros2_ws/src
git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/wuji-technology/wuji-retargeting.git
cd wuji-retargeting && pip install -e .
```

<Callout type="info">
The `--recurse-submodules` flag is required because the repository contains Git submodules.
</Callout>

### 3. Build

```bash
cd ~/ros2_ws
colcon build --symlink-install
source install/setup.bash
```
